meta.note: Natural Earth 1:50m physical land and admin-0 boundaries. Douglas–Peucker simplification with a per-ring tolerance of sqrt(area)/30° clamped to [0.02, 0.62], land rings under 0.3 square degrees dropped, boundaries at 0.42°, coordinates rounded to 2 decimal places (~1 km). Small island states — Singapore among them — fall below the area floor and are not drawn; their sites still plot at their true coordinates. Boundaries are Natural Earth's, shown for orientation and not as a position on any of them. Regenerate with scripts/world.mjs.
